name: SuperMe
description:
SuperMe is the AI-native professional network. It turns professionals’ real work, writing, talks, notes, meetings, and more, into AI-native profiles that make expertise discoverable.

With SuperMe in Claude, ask a business question and find the right professionals, get perspectives grounded in their work, compare answers, and go deeper with individual profiles. You can also search profiles and workgroups, ask a person, community, or group, talk to your personal My Agent, manage workgroups, and use files uploaded to SuperMe.

SuperMe brings the people and knowledge you trust into the tools where you already work.

_published_faq.name: How do I add SuperMe to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add SuperMe to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://mcp.superme.ai/. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: Is SuperMe MCP ready for ChatGPT and Claude?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 14, 2026, SuperMe scores 0/100 on Manufact's MCP publishing checklist. The scan does not yet meet ChatGPT publishing checks and does not yet meet Claude publishing checks. Passing these checks does not guarantee marketplace approval.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the SuperMe MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: SuperMe provides these MCP tools: 981f60a7a215_store_files, ask, ask_my_agent, file_manager, list_files, user_details_read, user_expert_search, user_profile_search, workgroup_create, workgroup_edit, and workgroup_list.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to SuperMe?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 18, 2026, alternatives to SuperMe in productivity on the Manufact MCP catalog include Autodesk Product Help, BoardWise, FlagStat, Keenable Web Search, and PomoDial.
SuperMe requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.

_published_faq.name: Why is SuperMe failing MCP readiness checks?

acceptedAnswer.text: SuperMe scored 0/100 on the latest Manufact MCP publishing checklist, below the 70-point checklist threshold. The top failing check is Authenticated MCP access is available. Reconnect the server account or provide a valid refreshable OAuth session, then rerun the audit. Paste the MCP URL into the Manufact MCP catalog to rerun the scan.
SuperMe is developed by Super Me Network, Inc. It is listed as community on the Claude connector directory.
